rationale.ai-review: Generative LLM evaluates code diffs to predict severe fault risk.
rationale.risk-routing: Uses predicted risk scores to gate diffs at thresholds for review.
rationale.built-system: Authors trained and evaluated iDiffLlama models on diff data.
rationale.adopted: Baseline logistic regression risk model is deployed in Meta's production.
rationale.general-code: Predicts risk for all code diffs, not just AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-quality: Mitigates quality risk by predicting severe faults (SEVs).
